sys_script_include.description: Builds the outbound VAMP payload (envelope plus one finding element) for an application vulnerable item. The sections and their fields come from the property x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.fields.<item table> (servicenow_field=<json structure>.<json field> per line); the remediation tasks of the item are a list, one entry per linked task.
sys_script_include.name: BOFASIVampOutboundProcessor

sys_script_include.description: Sends a VAMP payload with sn_ih_kafka.ProducerV2 to the Kafka topic whose sys_id is held in x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.kafka.topic_sys_id (key <table>.<sys_id>). Documentation of API used - https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/api-reference/server-api-reference/ProducerV2ScopedAPI.html
sys_script_include.name: BOFASIKafkaProducerVamp

sys_properties.description: sys_id of the Kafka Topic record [sys_kafka_topic] for sn_usem_verification_outbound, read by BOFASIKafkaProducerVamp.
sys_properties.name: x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.kafka.topic_sys_id

sys_properties.description: VAMP payload, one servicenow_field=json_field pair per line in payload order. On the left the ServiceNow field (verified with the field check script): the fields of the application vulnerable item plain, the fields of another section as <table>.<field>. On the right the payload name of the sheet "SN to VAMP" as <json structure>.<json field>; the sections of the payload are the structures in the order this property introduces them, and the section of a table reached through a many to many (the remediation tasks of the item) is a list, one entry per linked record. A field missing on the table or empty is sent as "".
sys_properties.name: x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.fields.sn_vul_app_vulnerable_item
sys_properties.value: sn_vul_app_vul_entry.number=tpe.number, sn_vul_app_vul_entry.u_vuln_sub_cat_id=tpe.u_vuln_sub_cat_id, sn_vul_app_vulnerability.number=remediation_task.number, sn_vul_app_vulnerability.u_primary_ait=remediation_task.primary_ait, sn_vul_app_vulnerability.u_avul_record_url=remediation_task.u_avul_record_url, number=finding.number, sys_created_on=finding.sys_created_on, sys_updated_on=finding.sys_updated_on, state=finding.state, cmdb_ci=finding.configuration_item, u_verification_status=finding.u_verification_status, source_avit_id=finding.source_avit_id, u_avit_record_url=finding.u_avit_record_url, sn_vul_pen_test_assessment_request.number=ptreq.number, sn_vul_pen_test_assessment_request.sys_created_on=ptreq.sys_created_on, sn_vul_pen_test_assessment_request.u_assessment_id=ptreq.u_assessment_id,

sys_script.description: Builds the VAMP payload for the application vulnerable item with BOFASIVampOutboundProcessor and sends it with BOFASIKafkaProducerVamp on every insert and update.
sys_script.name: BOFA_BR_AVIT_VampOutbound
